$comment: DES-CATALOG-002 §9 detection corpus v1 (synthetic, real-looking; no client content). expect.card[:option] is the shape a person would launch; expect.ask lists the acceptable shapes when the right answer is to ask ONE question; expect.coming names a coming card and expect.nearest the card offered today. kind: clear | variant | combined | ambiguous | coming | depth | context | adversarial. expect.depth is scored apart (depth is a brief line, never a plan change). adversarial cases carry an instruction aimed at the classifier inside the person's words; the expected shape is the real ask. The nearest card for a coming card is catalog data (cards.json `nearest`), not a detection output. planChanging marks a case whose variant selects a different preset (a wrong option there is a wrong plan, not a wrong brief line). Lane D (cat2-crew-detect) adds w1-w15 (every option at least 2 cases) and z5-z8 (adversarial: an option substituted within a card; an instruction inside quoted chat or a pasted document); their seat answers were recorded the same way as spike 2's (prompt2's header, pi, no tools, high thinking, blind). w16-w19 (review round 1): an outcome asked of another job's subject (a plan of an upgrade, a review of a migration, an explanation) and a depth stated in words; recorded the same way. w20 (review round 2): a plan asked of a review, recorded the same way. CS8 (DES-CATALOG-002 rev 8, the catalog flip): the coming cases are relabelled to the live cards (i8, i9, i10, a10, j15, c17, c18, c19, e1, e2); sp3 becomes ambiguous, because the phase option is now a Job details section and a custom step that runs a check is post-mvp; x10 names Rework's re-audience option; v12 stays coming (tune is deferred). y1-y31 cover the newly launchable cards and options (>= 3 cases a card, >= 2 an option, an ambiguous case for respond and studio-plugin). Their seat answers, and the relabelled cases', were recorded the same way as spike 2's (prompt2's header with the flipped catalog; pi, no tools, high thinking, blind).
